title: Sales and demand: channel revenue and margin
description: Where revenue comes from: retail pharmacies, hospital pharmacies and e-commerce.

list.name: disease_category
list.label: Disease category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT disease_category FROM mart.dim_medicine WHERE is_current AND medicine_key <> 0 ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT disease_category FROM mart.dim_medicine WHERE is_current AND medicine_key <> 0 ORDER BY 1

list.name: channel
list.label: Channel
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT channel_group FROM mart.agg_sales_month ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT channel_group FROM mart.agg_sales_month ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Net sales
panels.description: Sum of source-reported net sales (gross less discount), in US dollars.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd), 0) FROM mart.agg_sales_month a
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_id = a.medicine_id AND m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0
       WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
         AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category) AND a.channel_group IN ($channel)

SELECT coalesce(sum(a.quantity_sold_packs), 0) FROM mart.agg_sales_month a
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_id = a.medicine_id AND m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0
       WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
         AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category) AND a.channel_group IN ($channel)

SELECT coalesce(sum(a.transactions), 0) FROM mart.agg_sales_month a
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_id = a.medicine_id AND m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0
       WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
         AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category) AND a.channel_group IN ($channel)

panels.title: Gross margin
panels.description: Gross margin / net sales x 100 from summed amounts. It is almost the same in every channel and year (about 23.4%): the source applies a fixed markup.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * sum(a.gross_margin_usd) / NULLIF(sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd), 0), 2)
                 FROM mart.agg_sales_month a
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_id = a.medicine_id AND m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0
       WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
         AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category) AND a.channel_group IN ($channel)

panels.title: Return rate
panels.description: Packs returned / packs sold x 100. Returns are reported separately; net sales is not reduced for them in the source.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * sum(a.returned_quantity_packs) / NULLIF(sum(a.quantity_sold_packs), 0), 2)
                 FROM mart.agg_sales_month a
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_id = a.medicine_id AND m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0
       WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
         AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category) AND a.channel_group IN ($channel)

panels.title: 12-month growth
panels.description: Net sales in the latest 12 months vs the 12 months before, for the selected classes and channels (ignores the time picker; the ramp-up months fall outside both windows).

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (SELECT a.net_sales_amount_usd AS net, (a.year_month || '-01')::date AS m
                           FROM mart.agg_sales_month a
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_id = a.medicine_id AND m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0
       WHERE m.disease_category IN ($disease_category) AND a.channel_group IN ($channel))
                 SELECT round(100.0 * (sum(net) FILTER (WHERE m > (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) FROM mart.agg_sales_month) - interval '12 months')
                              - sum(net) FILTER (WHERE m <= (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) FROM mart.agg_sales_month) - interval '12 months'
                                                   AND m > (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) FROM mart.agg_sales_month) - interval '24 months'))
                          / NULLIF(sum(net) FILTER (WHERE m <= (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) FROM mart.agg_sales_month) - interval '12 months'
                                                      AND m > (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) FROM mart.agg_sales_month) - interval '24 months'), 0), 1) FROM w

panels.title: Net sales by month and channel (USD)
panels.description: Stacked monthly net sales for each channel. Jan-Feb 2023 are the sales ramp-up (data starts 2023-01-30). The tall bars follow large pharmacy deliveries in the source data. The axis ends at the last month with data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.year_month AS month, sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd) FILTER (WHERE a.channel_group = 'Retail pharmacy') AS "Retail pharmacy", sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd) FILTER (WHERE a.channel_group = 'Hospital pharmacy') AS "Hospital pharmacy", sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd) FILTER (WHERE a.channel_group = 'E-commerce') AS "E-commerce"
                 FROM mart.agg_sales_month a
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_id = a.medicine_id AND m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0
       WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
         AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category) AND a.channel_group IN ($channel) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Revenue share by channel (%)
panels.description: Each channel's share of net sales in the period, largest first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.channel_group AS channel,
                        round(100.0 * sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd) / sum(sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd)) OVER (), 1)
                          AS "Share of net sales (%)"
                 FROM mart.agg_sales_month a
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_id = a.medicine_id AND m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0
       WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
         AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category) AND a.channel_group IN ($channel) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Net sales per year by channel (USD)
panels.description: Yearly net sales, stacked by channel. The first year starts in the ramp-up, so it is understated.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Year ' || left(a.year_month, 4) AS year, sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd) FILTER (WHERE a.channel_group = 'Retail pharmacy') AS "Retail pharmacy", sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd) FILTER (WHERE a.channel_group = 'Hospital pharmacy') AS "Hospital pharmacy", sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd) FILTER (WHERE a.channel_group = 'E-commerce') AS "E-commerce"
                 FROM mart.agg_sales_month a
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_id = a.medicine_id AND m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0
       WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
         AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category) AND a.channel_group IN ($channel) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Growth by channel: last 12 months vs the 12 before
panels.description: Compares the latest 12 months with the previous 12, ignoring the time picker. The 2023 ramp-up months are outside both windows, so they cannot inflate growth.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (SELECT a.channel_group AS channel, a.net_sales_amount_usd AS net, (a.year_month || '-01')::date AS m
                            FROM mart.agg_sales_month a
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_id = a.medicine_id AND m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0
       WHERE m.disease_category IN ($disease_category) AND a.channel_group IN ($channel))
                  SELECT channel,
                         round(sum(net) FILTER (WHERE m <= (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) FROM mart.agg_sales_month) - interval '12 months'
                                                  AND m > (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) FROM mart.agg_sales_month) - interval '24 months'), 0) AS "previous 12 months (USD)",
                         round(sum(net) FILTER (WHERE m > (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) FROM mart.agg_sales_month) - interval '12 months'), 0) AS "latest 12 months (USD)",
                         round(100.0 * (sum(net) FILTER (WHERE m > (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) FROM mart.agg_sales_month) - interval '12 months')
                                - sum(net) FILTER (WHERE m <= (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) FROM mart.agg_sales_month) - interval '12 months' AND m > (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) FROM mart.agg_sales_month) - interval '24 months'))
                               / NULLIF(sum(net) FILTER (WHERE m <= (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) FROM mart.agg_sales_month) - interval '12 months'
                                                          AND m > (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) FROM mart.agg_sales_month) - interval '24 months'), 0), 1) AS "growth (%)"
                  FROM w GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Gross margin and returns by channel and year
panels.description: Margin rate is the ratio of summed margin to summed net sales. It moves by only a few hundredths of a point between channels and years, so it is shown as a table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.channel_group AS channel, left(a.year_month, 4) AS year,
                         round(sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd), 0) AS "net sales (USD)",
                         round(100.0 * sum(a.gross_margin_usd) / NULLIF(sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd), 0), 2) AS "gross margin (%)",
                         round(100.0 * sum(a.returned_quantity_packs) / NULLIF(sum(a.quantity_sold_packs), 0), 2) AS "returned packs (%)"
                  FROM mart.agg_sales_month a
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_id = a.medicine_id AND m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0
       WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
         AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category) AND a.channel_group IN ($channel) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

panels.title: Net sales by disease category (USD)
panels.description: Net sales by disease category in the selection, largest first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE m.disease_category WHEN 'Pain and Inflammatory Conditions' THEN 'Pain & Inflammation' WHEN 'Neurological and Mental Health Conditions' THEN 'Neuro & Mental Health' WHEN 'Gastrointestinal Disease' THEN 'Gastrointestinal' WHEN 'Cardiovascular Disease' THEN 'Cardiovascular' WHEN 'Respiratory Disease' THEN 'Respiratory' WHEN 'Infectious Disease' THEN 'Infectious' WHEN 'Diabetes Mellitus' THEN 'Diabetes' ELSE m.disease_category END AS "disease category", round(sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd), 0) AS "Net sales (USD)"
                 FROM mart.agg_sales_month a
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_id = a.medicine_id AND m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0
       WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
         AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category) AND a.channel_group IN ($channel) GROUP BY m.disease_category ORDER BY 2 DESC
